Introduction of Huazhong University of Science and Technology Editor Note: It is among the first Universities joining the national "211 Project" and "985 Project". The Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST) is a national key university directly under the administration of the Ministry of Education of P. R. China, and is among the first Universities joining the national "211 Project" and "985 Project". It was founded on May 26, 2000 as a result of the merger of the former Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Tongji Medical University and Wuhan Urban Construction Institute. Learn More>> 7.
